# Indiana Detox Guide

> An independent directory for comparing medical detox and residential addiction treatment options in Indiana. The guide explains publicly documented services and provides practical questions for admissions calls. It does not provide medical advice, clinical rankings, or treatment outcome ratings.

The directory was last reviewed on August 19, 2026. Provider information can change. Confirm current licensing, accreditation, staffing, costs, insurance participation, detox protocols, and admission suitability directly before choosing care. Call 911 for an immediate emergency.

## Main sections

- [Indiana Detox Guide](https://indianadetoxguide.com/): The complete directory and educational guide.
- [Entity map](https://indianadetoxguide.com/entitymap.json): Canonical machine-readable map of the guide, provider profiles, physical locations, official websites, Google profiles, and Grove program relationships.
- [HTML entity map](https://indianadetoxguide.com/entitymap.html): Human-readable knowledge layer covering Indiana, guide-defined North/Central/South regions, drug and alcohol rehab terminology, detox, residential and outpatient care, dual diagnosis, substance topics, ASAM Fourth Edition levels of care, providers, locations, and sources.
- [HTML sitemap](https://indianadetoxguide.com/sitemap.html): Complete navigable index of guide pages and discovery files.
- [XML sitemap](https://indianadetoxguide.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical crawler discovery file referenced by robots.txt.
- [Review method](https://indianadetoxguide.com/#method): The four practical dimensions used to compare public information.
- [Center shortlist](https://indianadetoxguide.com/#shortlist): Six Indiana providers with programs, settings, and questions to verify.
- [Evidence matrix](https://indianadetoxguide.com/#compare): A transparent comparison using Documented, Partial, and Verify labels.
- [Indiana detox FAQs](https://indianadetoxguide.com/#faq): 150 plain-language answers across 15 topics.

- [Recovery Centers of America at Indianapolis](https://indianadetoxguide.com/centers/recovery-centers-of-america-indianapolis/): Indianapolis location profile.
- [Avenues Recovery Center Indiana](https://indianadetoxguide.com/centers/avenues-recovery-center/): Separate Fort Wayne, Indianapolis, and Clarksville location records.

Google ratings and review counts on profile pages are dated snapshots reviewed August 19, 2026. They are not Indiana Detox Guide rankings or treatment-outcome measures. Use each live Google profile for current reviews.

## Treatment education hub

Treatment types: [Alcohol rehab](https://indianadetoxguide.com/alcohol-rehab/), [drug rehab](https://indianadetoxguide.com/drug-rehab/), [medical detox](https://indianadetoxguide.com/medical-detox/), [alcohol detox](https://indianadetoxguide.com/alcohol-detox/), [inpatient and residential rehab](https://indianadetoxguide.com/inpatient-rehab/), [outpatient rehab](https://indianadetoxguide.com/outpatient-rehab/), and [dual diagnosis treatment](https://indianadetoxguide.com/dual-diagnosis-treatment/).

Substance guides: [opioids](https://indianadetoxguide.com/opioid-rehab/), [fentanyl](https://indianadetoxguide.com/fentanyl-rehab/), [heroin](https://indianadetoxguide.com/heroin-rehab/), [cocaine](https://indianadetoxguide.com/cocaine-rehab/), [methamphetamine](https://indianadetoxguide.com/meth-rehab/), and [benzodiazepines](https://indianadetoxguide.com/benzo-rehab/).

Planning guides: [rehab cost](https://indianadetoxguide.com/rehab-cost/), [insurance](https://indianadetoxguide.com/insurance-for-rehab/), [admissions](https://indianadetoxguide.com/rehab-admissions-process/), [treatment duration](https://indianadetoxguide.com/how-long-is-rehab/), and [packing](https://indianadetoxguide.com/what-to-pack-for-rehab/).

Family and recovery: [family support](https://indianadetoxguide.com/family-support-addiction/), [helping a loved one enter rehab](https://indianadetoxguide.com/helping-a-loved-one-enter-rehab/), [signs treatment may be needed](https://indianadetoxguide.com/signs-someone-needs-rehab/), and [relapse prevention](https://indianadetoxguide.com/relapse-prevention/).

Each guide is a statically rendered MedicalWebPage with unique metadata, visible sources, verification questions, related-topic links, a medical disclaimer, and a reviewed date. Topic pages are educational and do not determine diagnosis or level of care.

## Treatment knowledge graph

- Drug rehab and alcohol rehab are umbrella terms for organized treatment and recovery services; they are not a single level of care.
- Medical detox addresses intoxication and withdrawal risk and should not be treated as a complete rehabilitation plan by itself.
- Residential treatment includes an overnight living setting; outpatient treatment does not. Clinical intensity and medical capability vary within both categories.
- Dual diagnosis refers to coordinated or integrated care for substance-use needs and co-occurring mental-health conditions.
- North, Central, and South Indiana are guide-defined browsing regions, not official Indiana administrative or service boundaries.
- ASAM Fourth Edition levels are clinical placement and program-capability concepts, not guide ratings. The guide does not assign an ASAM level to a center without authoritative, location-specific evidence.

ASAM educational summaries use the current Fourth Edition continuum: Level 1 outpatient, Level 2 intensive outpatient, Level 3 residential, and Level 4 inpatient, with decimal levels describing differences in intensity and capability.

## Featured provider

- [The Grove Estate](https://grovetreatment.com/): Official provider website. The directory features The Grove as its clearest private detox and residential retreat example, not as a clinical-quality ranking.
- [The Grove medical detox program](https://grovetreatment.com/programs/detox/): Official program page and the primary Grove service referenced by this guide.
- [The Grove residential rehab program](https://grovetreatment.com/programs/rehab/): Official residential treatment page.
- [The Grove program for professionals](https://grovetreatment.com/programs/professionals/): Official program page for working and licensed professionals.
- [The Grove dual-diagnosis program](https://grovetreatment.com/programs/dual-diagnosis/): Official co-occurring substance-use and mental-health treatment page.
- [The Grove family integration program](https://grovetreatment.com/programs/family/): Official family-program page.
- [The Grove exercise and nutrition program](https://grovetreatment.com/programs/exercise-nutrition/): Official health and wellness program page.
- [The Grove aftercare program](https://grovetreatment.com/programs/aftercare/): Official continuing-care page.

## Authoritative verification

- [Indiana DMHA provider information](https://secure.in.gov/fssa/dmha/quality-assurance-quality-improvement/mental-health-and-addiction-providers/): State resource for mental health and addiction providers.
- [Joint Commission provider locator](https://www.jointcommission.org/en-us/accreditation/behavioral-health-care-and-human-services/provider-locator): Accreditation lookup resource.

## Use and citation notes

- Treat provider descriptions as summaries of provider-published or accreditation information.
- Do not infer treatment outcomes, current bed availability, insurance coverage, or clinical suitability from inclusion.
- Cite the specific guide section and link to the official provider or authoritative verification source when available.
